pretreatments.description: Milling (grinding) the dried pine needles in an electric blender
Steam explosion of pine needles, involving autoclaving in flask plugged with non-absorbent cotton at 121 °C for 30 min
Acid-base-acid pretreatment with repeated exposure to HCl and NaOH followed by water washes until neutral pH
Coating with gold for FE-SEM analysis
